H3 — Asymptotic Theory

Crucial Distinction

Asymptotic pointwise intervals are for the
CATE, driven by the infinitesimal jackknife.
These are strictly different from finite-sample
marginal conformal intervals used for predicting
outcomes. Different estimand, different guarantees.

- Weights a; (x) are driven by leaf co-occurrence frequency.
- It learns its own definition of “similar” using only covariates that matter for effect heterogeneity,

not hand-scaled Euclidean distance.

H3 — Setup

- Units: Coin-event observations.
- Treatment W;: Binary indicator (1 = funding-rate

flip / listing / cascade, @ = matched non-event).

- Outcome Y;: Abnormal CAR over event window. Pre-
fitted on market model to strip out market-wide
moves. (Raw returns are invalid here).

- Modifiers X;: Market cap, realized vol, funding
history, book depth.

- Confounders W;: Regime variables shifting
probability and returns.

H3 — The Trading Signal

- Position Size: Scaled by |7| relative to interval
width.

- Edge Ratio: e = |7|/w

- Absolute No-Trade Filter: Do not trade if the
interval straddles zero.

- Construction: Market-neutral by balancing long
and short legs.

H3 — Interpreting the CATE Surface

Summarize_cate(cf, X, feature_names)

plot_cate_by_feature(cf, X, feature_idx)

A Feature Importance Shift

Heterogeneity importance # outcome importance.
A covariate can perfectly predict asset returns but
score absolute zero for effect heterogeneity.
Causal forests rank variables purely by how much
they drive the difference in effect.

A Marginal Plot Traps

Holding other covariates at the median for 1D
marginal plots can force you into regions of
covariate space with zero actual support. Read these
purely as mathematical descriptions of the fitted
surface, not as valid causal dose-response curves.

H3 — 3. SUTVA (Stable Unit Treatment Value Assumption)

Contagion Correlated

Pair MG — Y;(W;)

Definition: No interference
between units. One unit's

treatment must not affect

Market Maker Shared another's outcome.

The Crypto Reality: This is the weakest assumption in the crypto universe. A liquidation cascade
in one perpetual swap propagates directly through shared collateral pools into correlated pairs.
This is interference by definition.

Mitigation: Clustering standard errors by correlation group partially addresses the mathematical
fallout, but nothing fully resolves the structural violation.

H3 — Walk-Forward, With Two Wrinkles

Walk-Forward Validation

- Anchored walk-forward must pass Deflated
Sharpe Ratio (DSR) and Probability of Backtest
Overfitting (PBO) gates.

- Wrinkle 1: Purge overlapping event windows to
prevent out-of-sample contamination.

- Wrinkle 2: Redraw honest splits (Zspiit /Zest)
at every refit to avoid structural leakage.
